mapper.select: SELECT * FROM department WHERE enabled=TRUE ORDER BY id

SELECT id,code,name,spec,unit,price,stock,reserved,stock-reserved AS available_stock FROM drug enabled=TRUE AND (name LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR code LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY id

SELECT p.*,b.type,u.display_name AS patient_name FROM payment_record p JOIN bill b ON b.id=p.bill_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id=p.patient_id AND p.patient_id=#{patientId} AND p.bill_id=#{billId} ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.*,b.type,u.display_name AS patient_name FROM refund_record p JOIN bill b ON b.id=p.bill_id JOIN app_user u ON u.id=p.patient_id AND p.patient_id=#{patientId} AND p.bill_id=#{billId} ORDER BY p.id DESC
